issues.description: Lecture constructor signature is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement/UML requires a constructor initializing all five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), but the template provides only a 3-parameter constructor (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This can mislead students about the required constructor signature/order and causes their implementation to differ from the specified API.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template constructor signature to `public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors)` (in the UML order) and adjust the constructor TODO/body accordingly.
